output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is directly assigned to the target's balance, without any overflow check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, if the user's balance is less than 2^256/initialSupply.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'if (balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to]) throw;' can be triggered if the target's balance is large enough, allowing the owner to block the transfer.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'if (balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to]) throw;' can be triggered if the target's balance is large enough, allowing the owner to block the transfer.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is calculated by dividing the msg.value by buyPrice, if buyPrice is large enough, it can overflow and cause a buy function to be frozen.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is multiplied by sellPrice, if sellPrice is large enough, it can overflow and cause a sell function to be frozen.
